Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

If I use this card's  effect to play a Digimon from digivolution cards when my Digimon with the[Legend-Arms] trait and [EX6-042 RaijiLudomon] in its digivolution cards would be deleted, can I then use [EX6-042 RaijiLudomon]'s inherited effect to prevent the deletion?

Effect: While you have a [Legend-Arms] trait Digimon, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] You may place 1 [Legend-Arms] trait Digimon card from your trash as 1 of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon would leave the battle area other than by one of your effects,＜Delay＞.
・You may play 1 [Legend-Arms] trait card from that Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
